description: A house-style vector.json that breaks the vector profile schema or a check's options schema (a zero stroke width, an empty radius list, a token reference with no token source, an unknown field, options on a check that takes none) is left out with an issue saying why, so check_vector_style runs no checks and fix_vector_style changes nothing.

issues.message: vector.json is left out: palette[1]: "brand/primary" is a token reference, but this host has no design tokens to resolve it. /strokeWidths/0: Must be > 0. /cornerRadii: Must have at least 1 items. /palette/1: Expected string, got undefined. /fonts/0: Must be at least 1 characters. /extra: Unknown property "extra". Allowed: strokeWidths, cornerRadii, palette, fonts. checks[1] (corner-radii)/snap: Unknown property "snap". checks[2] (palette-only)/tolerance: Must be <= 20. checks[4]: expected a check id or { "id": ..., options }.
